gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
A sales rep will follow ___ your enquiry next week.
gaps.explanation: follow up = take further action after something.
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.

gaps.sentence: Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!
It's time you faced up ___ your responsibilities.
gaps.explanation: face up TO something = accept and deal with something difficult.

gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.
